headline: [No Rush!] Trump Delays Iran Strike Decision Until [After New Year]
caption:
🌍 Trump: No Rush on New Iran Strikes, Decision After New Year

US President Donald Trump said that he is "not rushing" to decide on new strikes on Iran. Speaking to Israel's Channel 12, he said: "We'll see what happens after the new year starts."

🔹 The New York Times reported that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pushing the US to join a new 4-to-7-day campaign of strikes on Iran.
🔹 In a Fox News interview, Trump said there is "indication" Iran is "looking at gases, looking at bio". Iran's foreign ministry called the chemical weapons allegations "fraudulent".
🔹 No final decision has been made yet. Earlier this week the US carried out what it called "defensive strikes" on Iran's Qeshm Island.

💬 Do you think talks can stop another round of strikes? 👇

Sources: CBS News, The Times of Israel, The Jerusalem Post

headline: [Third Term Bid!] El Salvador's Bukele Files to Run Again in [2027]
caption:
🗳️ El Salvador's Bukele Files to Run for a Third Term

El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele has officially signed up to run for a third term. He handed in his candidate papers to the Supreme Electoral Tribunal on Thursday night, the last day for registration.

🔹 The presidential election is set for February 28, 2027. Bukele leads the Nuevas Ideas (New Ideas) party, which controls the country's congress.
🔹 A 2025 constitutional change allowed him to run again and made the presidential term six years instead of five.
🔹 Recent polls put his approval at around 90%. Opposition figures and international observers say his plan to stay in office is illegal.

💬 Should presidents have term limits? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera / Reuters

#GlobalEye #ElSalvador #Bukele #Election2027 #LatinAmerica #WorldNews

headline: [Bridge Attack!] Russian Missiles Hit Three Kyiv Bridges, [8 Killed] in Ukraine
sub: Strikes follow Putin's warning over Kerch Bridge
caption:
🇺🇦 Russian Missiles Hit Three Kyiv Bridges, 8 Killed in Ukraine

Russia launched a large overnight attack on Ukraine on Thursday night into Friday, using missiles and drones. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said ballistic missiles damaged the Podilskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges over the Dnipro River, and traffic on them has been restricted.

🔹 Ukraine's prime minister said at least 8 people were killed across the country, including 6 in Kyiv, and 28 were wounded.
🔹 Power was cut in parts of Kyiv. Ukraine's energy ministry said nuclear plants had to reduce output, causing outages in Kyiv and 10 regions.
🔹 Russia's Defence Ministry said it targeted bridges "used to transport weapons". On Thursday, Putin promised to respond after Ukraine damaged the Kerch Bridge to Crimea.

💬 Will attacks on bridges change the course of the war? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera / Reuters, AP

#GlobalEye #Ukraine #Kyiv #Russia #UkraineWar #WorldNews
